mentions.name: Lipwise
mentions.description: A narration app with an LLM in the pipeline that can fix mistakes and perform transformations, capable of running fully local even on mediocre machines. It has no telemetry, is lightweight, and is fully open source.
mentions.source_excerpt: Lipwise (https://getlipwise.com) is a narration app with an LLM in the pipeline capable of fixing mistakes and doing transformations, and the best thing is even with a mediocre machine it can be fully local. No telemetry, lightweight and fully open source https://github.com/lnenad/lipwise
mentions.author: lnenad
